prompt_loading: Read UTF-8 file and strip leading/trailing whitespace; preserve all internal content including examples
source_input: Sentence-restored original chunk only, no question/options/gold answer/semantic label
preservation_requirements: Keep stable document ID, full source text, original raw response and model/prompt versions
Keep each claim and its evidence linked to that source; case/study statements are not universal facts
Do not merge anonymous patients/studies across documents based on repeated descriptive phrases
A valid empty proposition list is permitted for a question-only title
Do not silently truncate inputs/outputs or silently repair semantic content
Flag malformed JSON, output truncation and non-exact evidence for review/retry; exact quotation does not prove entailment
quality_scope: 32 development + 16 previously unseen extraction documents; direct assistant review, not expert gold or untouched QA-test evaluation
limits: Not validated on other checkpoints or all 88294 documents. Missing antecedents, OCR, quantifier scope and omissions remain possible. Full corpus generation not launched.
